en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall church tower with a clock and spire on the left, a large brick church with a steep gabled roof behind it, and in the foreground an ornate wooden and stone building complex on a landscaped slope with trees and bushes. Handwritten text and a date appear at the top, and printed publisher information runs vertically along the right edge.
